description: This file defines the DirectionserviceProvider class for an Angular/Ionic app, handling route calculations, distance matrix requests, and related UI updates for a taxi booking application.

classes.name: DirectionserviceProvider
classes.description: Angular service provider for calculating routes and distances, updating UI and handling route-related logic in a taxi booking app.

methods.name: calcRoute
methods.description: Calculates route distance and duration between start and stop points, updates internal state, and triggers callback.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Handles the response from Google Distance Matrix API, updates UI, calculates fare, and manages route errors.

methods.name: UpdateInformation
methods.description: Updates destination information in the backend and confirms with user.
